entities.summary: Manuel Margot Gomez is a Dominican professional baseball center fielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Tampa Bay Rays, Minnesota Twins, and Detroit Tigers. He made his MLB debut in 2016 with the Padres.
